headline_seed: F.B.I. Agents Search Eric Swalwell’s Home as Part of Federal Inquiry - The New York Times
draft_text:
#BreakingMews: USA Today reports FBI agents executed search warrants on former Rep. Eric Swalwell, seizing his phone at SFO and searching his D.C. residence, tied to a sexual-misconduct investigation. Not yet verified.

reported by USA Today; also covered by The New York Times.
